verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. Sequential checking confirms the continuity and exact one-dimensional nodal-envelope computation, the construction and semipositivity of the minorants, the singleton-Shilov maximum-principle obstruction, the product section identity, the node and Gauss-point bounds after upper-semicontinuous regularization, and the reduced pure-dimensional affinoid-algebra calculation. All external results were checked first with the theorem-search service and then, where needed, against the official arXiv texts; their definitions, hypotheses, and implication directions match the uses in the proof.
